observation: static source only; no environment values or deployed identity attested

response_modes.primary: strict json_schema from DNAAnalysis via strict_schema()

generation.tier: Primary if TMDB popularity >=1.0 or release date within the last calendar year through today; otherwise fallback first. Each can try the other.
generation.retry: At most 6 requests per title total; per model one validation repair, at most two transport retries for 429/502/503 honoring Retry-After or exponential delay. No quality retry. All-zero scores skip repair and try alternate model. Non-budget 401/403 raise.
generation.spend_pause: 402 => next UTC midnight; explicit monthly-budget 403 => next UTC month; Redis longest pause wins; unprocessed claims released. Provider $1/day $30/month limits are historical owner configuration, not verified live.
generation.persistence: Mongo analysis, generation timestamp, raw ordered vector, route name and release saved together; vector persistence rechecks stored scores with conditional update and no model call.

query_reading.requests: Two parallel locked requests: lean full-criteria attributes/concrete words/phrase choice, plus 148 want/avoid noul questions (74 keys).
query_reading.weight: 2*(want-avoid); wanted >=0.5, avoided <=-1.2; up to 74 dims, strongest fallback if empty
query_reading.contract_cache_key: d4+/<model>/<questionVersion>/<language.mode>/<language.version> plus canonical requests/language/text via keyed digest
query_reading.reading_normalization: lowercase + collapsed whitespace; original text kept elsewhere; request key normalizes NFC
query_reading.rate_config: 42 nanoUSD/input token; typesafe-public-2026-09-21-42nano-v1 (dated source constant, not current price verification)
query_reading.language: five-language-markers-v2; optional gpt-4.1-nano translation only when SEARCH_TRANSLATION_ENABLED=true; runtime env not read
query_reading.admission: shared store, cache, claim, limits and settlement; errors retain unknown-usage reservation, not assumed zero

title_text.inputs: Qdrant payload title/original_title/release_year/genres/tropes plus Crate original_title, essence_text, tags, substr(synopsis,1,600), keywords/tropes fallback. Stores may differ.
title_text.english: No title or prefix, year retained; genres + tags + essence_text or synopsis + first 25 keywords + first 15 tropes. Exact punctuation/order frozen in source.
title_text.multilingual: passage: prefix + title or original_title and same body
title_text.sparse: All tags/keywords/tropes/essence fields, no dense top-N cuts; stable term IDs, local tokenization/stemming, field weights 2/2/1/1, K1=1.2, B=.75 and frozen float32 average lengths.
title_text.hash: SHA256 JSON of [contract, english_text, multilingual_text, term_fields]

query_bge.prefix: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:

encoders.runtime: fp32 CPU ONNX; L2 normalization. Title max512/batch32/threads4; query config max512 but worker caps128; search role defaults2 threads, in-flight4; other roles use core-dependent default. Environment overrides unverified.
encoders.parity_qualification: Different multilingual title/query ONNX byte identities, with historical encoder parity evidence; no new binary or vector parity run. Do not equate model-name agreement with byte identity.

vectors.fingerprint_v1: 74 Cosine, raw score input normalized by Qdrant

qdrant.ownership: Fingerprint publish updates owned vectors/payload and retains text vectors. Text publish updates only its three vectors.

sync_checkpoint.success_rule: Commit checkpoint only after media type succeeds; carried missing-streaming IDs retained. ID-scoped runs keep fixed window and do not advance scheduled checkpoint.

text_pipeline.sweep: Daily full input-hash sweep catches older-source timestamp publication; no full run performed.

search_index.eligibility: votes>=2000 and not adult; alias rules/version retained
search_index.blobs: search_index_files: deterministic gzip JSON addressed by SHA-1; runtime checks SHA-1. Audit uses SHA-256 of captured files.
search_index.publication: Build files + reference profiles, then complete/current CAS; retains current/previous and running builds. No live build captured.

title_snapshot.ratings_sidecar: format1; 2+country_count bytes/title, separate chunk hashes; precise layout in source
title_snapshot.source_mark: Per movie/show count and sum(dna_updated_at), plus ratings-format/config inputs; metadata freshness is not a live evidence attestation.

ranker.scope: Current source identity is separate from historical combo-safe-v2/v3 prototype names. Fusion/config/layout/consumer files are captured, no ranking run performed.
